list.title: Saved groups
list.description: Audiences you define once and target from any flag rule or experiment. Changing a group updates everything that uses it.
list.emptyDescription: Save an audience such as beta testers, internal staff or enterprise accounts, then target it with "is in saved group" instead of repeating the same conditions.

new.title: New saved group
new.description: Define who is in the group. Flags and experiments then target it by name.

form.name: Name
form.keyHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _. Can't be changed later
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Who is in this group and why
form.typeList: Users whose attribute is one of the IDs you paste
form.attributeHelp: The user attribute compared with the list, usually id
form.idsHelp: One per line, or paste a comma-separated list. Up to {{max}}; every SDK downloads the list.
form.idsTooMany: A list can hold at most {{max}} IDs
form.liveNote: Changes apply immediately to every flag and experiment that targets this group.

detail.savedDescription: SDKs receive the new membership on their next refresh.
detail.unused: Nothing targets this group yet. Choose "is in saved group" in a flag rule or experiment's targeting.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: Flags and experiments will no longer be able to target this group. This can't be undone.
